answer: The vouch-quorum budget caps each established identity at k endorsements per epoch; a newcomer needs q distinct vouchers, with slots shuffled by the epoch beacon so colluders cannot target one ring. Each voucher posts a basalt-denominated bond slashed if its endorsees sybil, and every raven audit samples a random vouch edge. An attacker must bond q identities, pay k-limited endorsement prices, and wait epochs to earn weight; a ring fails because shared vouchers exceed the cap and audit slashes bonds.
